articles.text: MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Āi, zhèige qīngjiāo hǎo dà a! Yě hěn xīnxian, shi běndì chūde ba?
AMERICAN: Wow! These green peppers are so big! They're very fresh, too. They must be local produce, aren't they?
SHÒUHUÒYUÁN: Shi cóng jiāoqū láide.
SALESPERSON: They come from the suburbs.
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Běijīng jiāoqūde rénmín gōngshè dōu zhòng shūcài ma?
AMERICAN: Do all the people's communes in the suburbs of Běijīng grow vegetables?
SHÒUHUÒYUÁN: Xiànzàide rénmín gōngshè zhǔyào háishi zhòng liángshi, jiāoqūde gōngshè yǒu xiē dàduì zhòng shūcài, dāngrán yě yǒu zhuānyèhuàde gōngshè.
SALESPERSON: These days most people's communes still mainly produce grain. In communes in the suburbs, some brigades grow vegetables, and, of course, there are also specialized communes.
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Zhuānyèhuà shi shénme yìsi?
AMERICAN: What does specialized mean?
SHÒUHUÒYUÁN: Zěnme shuō ne? Wǒ shìzhe jǔ ge lìzi ba.
SALESPERSON: How should I explain it? I'll try and give you an example.
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Ng, nǐ shuōshuo kàn.
AMERICAN: Mm, go ahead.
SHÒUHUÒYUÁN: Bǐrú shuō Sìjìqīng zhèige gōngshè.
SALESPERSON: For instance, the commune Sìjìqīng.
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: "Sìjìqīng" shi shénme yìsi?
AMERICAN: What does "Sìjìqīng" mean?
SHÒUHUÒYUÁN: Ng, "yī èr sān sì"de "sì," "chūnjì qiūjì"de "jì," "qīng" jiù shi lǜde yìsi.
SALESPERSON: Sì ("four") as in yī èr sān sì ("one two three four"); jì ("season") as in chūnjì, qiūjì ("spring season, fall season"). Qīng means "green."
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Ā! Nà shi sìjì cháng lǜde yìsi.
AMERICAN: Ah! So it means "green all year round."
SHÒUHUÒYUÁN: Duì le, jiù shi yīnwei nèige gōngshè sìjì dōu shi lǜde, wǒmen cái bǎ tā jiào Sìjìqīng. Nà shi ge xiānjìnde gōngshè. Tāmen jiù zhòng cài!
SALESPERSON: Right. It's precisely because the commune is green all year round that we call it Sìjìqīng. It's an advanced commune. They grow only vegetables!
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Jiù zhòng cài?! Ā! Duì le, duì le, suǒyǐ guǎn zhèige gōngshè jiào zhuānyèhuà gōngshè.
AMERICAN: Only vegetables? Oh! Of course. That's why they call it a specialized commune.
SHÒUHUÒYUÁN: Ou, wǒ shuōde "jiù zhòng cài" bú shi shuō bǎifēnzhī bǎi a! Jiù shi shuō, càidìde miànjī hěn dà, zhàn gōngshè zǒng miànjīde bǎifēnzhī qī-bāshí!

SALESPERSON: Oh, when I said "only vegetables," I didn't mean one hundred percent! I mean that the area of their vegetable plots is very large. They make up seventy or eighty percent of the commune's total area!
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Suǒyǐ zhèige xiānjìn gōngshè zhǔyàode shēngchǎn shi shūcài!
AMERICAN: So the main product of this advanced commune is vegetables!
SHÒUHUÒYUÁN: Duì le, yìdiǎnr dōu bú cuò! Zhèige dà qīngjiāo jiù shi cóng nàr láide. Duō mǎi jǐge ba!
SALESPERSON: Right, absolutely correct. These big green peppers are from there. Buy a bunch of them!
MĚIGUÓ RÉN: Hǎo, wǒ mǎi yìjīn.
AMERICAN: Okay, I'll take one catty.
